mapper.select: SELECT s.REALNAME, o.ORGNAME, j.RNAME, ROUND(MONTHS_BETWEEN(SYSDATE, s.CREATETIME) / 12, 2) AS GL FROM TBL_STAFF s LEFT JOIN TBL_ORGANIZATION o ON s.ORGID = o.ORGID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT s.USERNAME, REGEXP_SUBSTR(s.ROLEIDSTRS, '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL) AS rid FROM TBL_STAFF s WHERE s.ROLEIDSTRS IS NOT NULL CONNECT BY LEVEL <= REGEXP_COUNT(s.ROLEIDSTRS, ',') + 1 AND s.USERNAME = PRIOR s.USERNAME AND PRIOR DBMS_RANDOM.VALUE IS NOT NULL ) split_roles ON s.USERNAME = split_roles.USERNAME LEFT JOIN TBL_ROLE j ON split_roles.rid = j.RID WHERE s.CREATETIME IS NOT NULL
